definition: A specification for broadcasting defined data formats from Bluetooth Low Energy beacons.
entry_text: A specification for broadcasting defined data formats from Bluetooth Low Energy beacons.
example: A receiver interprets an Eddystone frame sent by a nearby beacon.
label: Eddystone
sense_note: Do not assume support for any discontinued Google beacon service.

sources.note: Google’s archived specification describes Bluetooth Low Energy proximity beacon messages and their frame formats. This does not establish support for any associated cloud service.
